name: design
description: Phase 2 (Design) worker — IN PROGRESS at v0.4.0: `help`, `init`, `overview` and `function` work; the other eleven commands in the design specification are declared-not-built and labelled as such in commands/help.md, so invoking one produces nothing rather than a guess. Turns the requirement spine produced by `req` into two renderings of one truth: a Thai narrative document a client can sign, and structured JSON downstream plugin agents act on without asking a clarifying question. Reads req through scripts/req-contract.mjs, the single place that knows the shape of req output, and HALTS with exit 2 naming the path it looked for when a mandatory input is absent or malformed rather than inferring it. Business rules are REFERENCED as req BR-xxx@vN, never re-minted as a design-owned id, because two ids for one rule drift apart the moment /req:change moves a version. The trace graph is derived from the artifacts rather than hand-written, split by author into trace.design.json so a regeneration can never eat another plugin edges. Judgement stays with the owner and arithmetic stays with the scripts: a command never invents scope, a rule or a flow, it validates that they were written down and renders what they say. Generated documents are never hand-edited and carry no edit-here markers. Every command is idempotent, reads design.state.json before acting, halts when a preceding step is not done, and writes nothing without --write.
